page_title: VIL 1-5 BAR | Villarreal v Barcelona 22/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+3' Ilias Akhomach plays the ball through an opponents legs to Thierno Barry (Villarreal), who shoots from the edge of the box. The keeper scrambles across his line but the shot rises just over the bar.
90+2' Barcelona keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
90+1' Tempers flare after Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
88' The current number of shots on goal is 4:10.
87' Eric Bailly (Villarreal) sends a long ball in, but Inaki Pena comfortably gathers the ball.
85' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

83' 1 - 5 GOAL! Superb work from Lamine Yamal, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Raphinha (Barcelona), who beats Diego Conde with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 1:5.
82' Pau Victor (Barcelona) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Inigo Martinez as he is replaced by Hector Fort (Barcelona).

80' Inaki Pena makes a brilliant save! Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by keeper!
78' Santi Comesana goes off the pitch and Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) comes on.
78' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Denis Suarez (Villarreal) replaces Nicolas Pepe.
78' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alex Baena.
77' Raphinha (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
74' 1 - 4 Raphinha (Barcelona) receives a great pass from his teammate and strikes a very powerful shot towards goal that goes inside of the right post!
74' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
73' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
70' It's time for a substitution. Pape Gueye (Villarreal) comes on in place of Dani Parejo.
69' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Villarreal due to an offside in the build-up play.
69' The Villarreal players halt their celebrations as referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
68' It's a goal! Thierno Barry (Villarreal) bravely launches himself at a cross from Sergi Cardona and gives Inaki Pena no chance with a close-range bullet header into the bottom left corner. 2:3.

68' Raphinha (Barcelona) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Diego Conde shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
67' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort crashes against the left post.
66' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
66' Eric Bailly (Villarreal) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
66' The Barcelona players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

65' There's a break in play and referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Barcelona using VAR. This could be interesting!
64' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thierno Barry (Villarreal) replaces Yeremy Pino.
61' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Barcelona.

61' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
59' We are about to witness a substitution. Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) is replacing Sergi Dominguez.
59' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pau Victor (Barcelona) replacing Pablo Torre.
59' The referee signals a substitution. Marc Casado (Barcelona) is brought on as a substitute for Pedri.
58' 1 - 3 Pablo Torre (Barcelona) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
56' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
55' Pablo Torre (Barcelona) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
53' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!
52' Villarreal earn a corner.
52' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
51' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Inaki Pena makes a great save to stop his effort.
50' The goal by Villarreal is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
50' The Villarreal players joy may have been justified, because referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
48' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
47' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
46' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) gets on the end of a cross from Sergi Cardona, but his shot goes a whisker wide of the right post.
45+5' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Logan Costa (Villarreal) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
45+4' Villarreal force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+4' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
45+3' Substitution. Marc-Andre ter Stegen will be replaced by Inaki Pena (Barcelona).
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Marc-Andre ter Stegen (Barcelona) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
44' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Alex Baena (Villarreal) took the corner.

43' Marc-Andre ter Stegen pulls off a great save to deny Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
42' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
41' Alex Baena (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' PENALTY APPEAL after Jules Kounde (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
39' Raphinha (Barcelona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

38' 1 - 2 Goal! Nicolas Pepe plays in Ayoze Perez (Villarreal), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders. He shoots from inside the box into the right side of the net! Great finish - 1:2.
37' Pablo Torre (Barcelona) is penalised for holding. Mateo Busquets Ferrer signals a set piece.
35' 0 - 2 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
35' Pablo Torre (Barcelona) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
34' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Raphinha (Barcelona) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
34' Villarreal will take a corner kick.
33' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Villarreal have a corner.
32' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Villarreal.

31' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play and Villarreal manage to earn a corner.
29' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
28' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the bottom left corner, but Diego Conde pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
27' Sergi Dominguez (Barcelona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
25' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Diego Conde comes off his line to gather the ball.
24' A precise low pass is received by Dani Parejo (Villarreal), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
22' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.

20' 0 - 1 Pablo Torre feeds the ball through to Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the right side of the goal! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:1!
19' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is adjudged offside.
18' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Pedri (Barcelona), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
18' Barcelona win a corner.
17' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he fails to change the score as his effort deflects away off the left post.
16' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

14' Great solo effort by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save.
13' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Diego Conde is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
12' None of the Villarreal players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

11' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
8' The goal by Villarreal won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
8' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer is going to take a look using VAR.
6' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
5' A cross into the box finds the head of Raphinha (Barcelona) who steers it goalwards, but Diego Conde manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
4' Barcelona are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
2' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Villarreal will take the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
